name: Ample Classes Are Closed Under One-Coordinate Fiber Products
statement: If two ample binary classes have exactly one shared coordinate and otherwise disjoint coordinate sets, then their coordinate fiber product is ample, including the empty output convention.
proof: A shattered private support sees a union of two rectangles, one at each shared-coordinate height. An elementary rectangle classification shows that either one same-height product realizes the support or one factor realizes it at both heights while the other realizes it across the shared coordinate. Positioned cubes in the ample factor sections then combine. A support containing the shared coordinate is handled by combining the corresponding positioned cubes in both factors.
